idea-plugin.name: gRPC StreamObserver Contract Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Warning icon on a .onNext(...) or .onError(...) call on a gRPC StreamObserver found, in textual order, AFTER an .onCompleted() call on the same receiver, within the same method body -- gRPC's own StreamObserver javadoc states the contract explicitly: onNext "is never called after onError(Throwable) or onCompleted() are called", and "onCompleted may only be called once and if called it must be the last method called". Calling either after completion is a real, documented contract violation, not just a style nit.

100% static text/PSI analysis -- matches receiver/method names by simple text, so it works whether the real gRPC jar is on the classpath or not. Java and Kotlin. Confirmed gap: no bundled or third-party Marketplace plugin covers this specific ordering check (existing gRPC plugins are navigation/documentation tools).

Stated honestly: v0.1 only catches the straight-line, same-method-body case (both calls as direct statements, textual order = execution order) -- doesn't trace calls split across branches/loops/helper methods, and a call guarded by an early return between the two is a possible false positive not traced here.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.
